mappings.evidence_note: Pearson 9PH0 Issue 3 concept-led content: the subset required for AS (8PH0) is statements 1-96 (printed pages 8-16); the remainder of the A level is statements 97-191 (pages 17-25). Every statement belongs to exactly one year, so all coverage is full.

AQA 7037 specification section 6.2 (page 53): "There is overlapping content in the AS and A-level Geography specifications. This helps you teach the AS and A-level together." Year 12 is the content AS 7036 shares with the A level (matched section by section with text similarity recorded in the spec), plus the AS-only fieldwork enquiry leaf; Year 13 is the A-level-only content (hot deserts, ecosystems under stress, global systems and governance, population and the environment, resource security, A-level fieldwork requirements). This is a co-teaching basis, not an AQA-prescribed teaching order: schools may sequence differently.

OCR H446 specification section 2b (page 11): the A Level "has been designed to be co-teachable with the stand alone AS Level in Computer Science". Year 12 is the content AS H046 shares with the A level (every AS lettered point matched to an A-level point, similarities recorded in the spec) plus the two AS-only testing points; Year 13 is A-level-only content. This is a co-teaching basis, not an OCR-prescribed teaching order: schools may sequence differently.

AQA 7181/7182 specification Version 1.4: "We have designed the AS and A-level specifications to cover the core areas of Psychology and be fully co-teachable within the first year of study" and section 6.2: "There is overlapping content in the AS and A-level Psychology specifications. This helps you teach the AS and A-level together." Year 12 is the content AS 7181 (specification section 3) shares with the A level, matched bullet by bullet with text similarity recorded in the spec; Year 13 is the A-level-only content (psychodynamic and humanistic approaches, comparison of approaches, ways of studying the brain, localisation and lateralisation, the A-level-only research methods, issues and debates, and the Paper 3 options). This is a co-teaching basis, not an AQA-prescribed teaching order: schools may sequence differently.

AQA 7191/7192 specification Version 1.2: the AS (section 3) repeats a subset of the A-level content so the two can be co-taught. Year 12 is the content AS 7191 shares with the A level on this route (education, methods in context, the research-methods half of theory and methods, families and households), matched bullet by bullet with text similarity recorded in the spec; Year 13 is the A-level-only content (sociological theory, science, value freedom and social policy, beliefs in society, crime and deviance). This is a co-teaching basis, not an AQA-prescribed teaching order: schools may sequence differently.

Pearson 9ET0 Issue 11 and AS 8ET0 Issue 8: the AS sets Poems of the Decade (the same prescribed poems), A Streetcar Named Desire and the Science and Society prose texts, so these can be co-taught in Year 12. Year 13 is the A-level-only content on this route (Othello with critical reading, unseen poetry, The Romantics). This is a co-teaching basis, not a Pearson-prescribed teaching order: schools may sequence differently.

OCR H432 specification (Version 3.1): the A Level "is co-teachable with the AS level" and its topics are split over modules to facilitate co-teaching. Year 12 is Modules 1 to 4, the content AS H032 assesses (same section numbers and titles in both specifications); Year 13 is Modules 5 and 6, A-level only. This is a co-teaching basis, not an OCR-prescribed teaching order: schools may sequence differently.
